headline: Airbnb (ABNB) Heads Into Earnings Focus, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
summary: Airbnb (ABNB) is back in focus as Wall Street looks ahead to its June quarter earnings report on August 6, with expectations centered on higher revenue and year over year earnings growth. See our latest analysis for Airbnb. At a share price of $152.08, Airbnb has posted a 14.34% year to date share price return and a 14.86% total shareholder return over the past year. The recent 10.55% 7 day share price move suggests momentum is building ahead of earnings as investors react to fresh earnings...
